name: glance
description: macOS overlay that answers questions about your screen and calls with Claude or any OpenAI-compatible model, and saves meeting notes

scripts.package: sh scripts/bundle-whisper.sh && electron-packager . Glance --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --app-bundle-id=com.glance.overlay --out=dist --overwrite --ignore='^/dist' --ignore='^/build' --ignore='^/test' --ignore='^/README.md' --ignore='^/docs' --ignore='^/scripts' --ignore='^/PLAN.md' --asar.unpackDir='{models,vendor,node_modules/audiotee/bin}' --extend-info=build/extra.plist && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/Glance-darwin-arm64/Glance.app && codesign --force --sign - --requirements '=designated => identifier "com.glance.overlay"' dist/Glance-darwin-arm64/Glance.app
